items.title: Do AI coding agents struggle with non-REST APIs?
items.summary: Should your next API be REST, or something else? And which one will AI coding agents handle best? We tested REST, POST-only and RPC-style APIs with six models across 1,356 runs, and what decided whether agents succeeded had nothing to do with API style.The post Do AI coding agents struggle with non-REST APIs? appeared first on Microsoft for Developers.
items.creator: Waldek Mastykarz
